explication: March7thAssistant automates Honkai: Star Rail tasks through a CLI or graphical interface. The principal runtime path is user-selected task → command dispatch → task implementation → game automation and screen/OCR support; task outcomes can be sent through configured notification channels. The README also documents cloud play, custom workflows, update support, toolbox functions, and scheduled or conditional startup. Source excerpts and the index support the main runtime and several internal links; other documented capabilities are included with only README-backed connections where implementation wiring was not sampled.
